prompt: Set up a pencil design system in this project. The repo currently has no design-system/ folder.

assertions.text: Asks for confirmation or offers the scaffold before writing any files (does not silently scaffold)
Names all 12 core templates to be created: README.md, design-system.md, tokens.md, components.md, layout.md, motion.md, elevation.md, iconography.md, patterns.md, states.md, voice.md, code-export.md
Mentions the 4 optional templates (mobile.md, data-viz.md, brand.md, imagery.md) and the signals or opt-in that triggers each
Mentions handling the case where a design-system/ folder already exists containing code files (does not blindly overwrite)
Tells the user which fields or sections to fill in first (e.g. tokens.md, design-system.md path)
